notes: The two italicized junctures inside the asyndetic ψαλμοῖς / ὕμνοις / ᾠδαῖς list are `added` under rule 98, not rule 88 helpers: no participle-to-finite conversion is in question and no source token carries the coordination.
ἐνοικείτω's ἐν- preverb is answered by the expressed ἐν, which keeps its own 'in', so the verb keeps only 'Let … dwell' (rules 36, 106).

The bare datives take their case preposition on the noun, no article standing to anchor it (rules 21, 24); the articles before 'hearts' and 'God' are emptied by the possessive and by the absence of a determiner respectively (rules 20, 23).
